title: Allowance Cap by Enrollment Tenure, FBN Warehouse-Loss Approvals
content:
| Whole months the Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment has been active since its activation date | Allowance cap on a warehouse-loss approval |
|---|---|
| 24 or more (long tenure) | 3 units (long-tenure allowance cap) |
| at least 12 but fewer than 24 (mid tenure) | 5 units (mid-tenure allowance cap) |
| fewer than 12 | not altered by this schedule |

**Schedule rule.** The allowance cap is the long-tenure allowance cap of 3 units for an enrollment active at least the long tenure of 24 whole months since its activation date, and the mid-tenure allowance cap of 5 units for an enrollment active at least the mid tenure of 12 whole months but fewer than the long tenure of 24 whole months. An enrollment active fewer than 12 whole months is outside this schedule.

Whole months are counted from the activation date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month.

## Boundaries (hypothetical activation dates, handling date 15 September)

| Activated | Whole months | Cap under this schedule |
|---|---|---|
| 15 September, two years earlier | 24 | 3 units |
| 16 September, two years earlier | 23 | 5 units |
| 15 September, one year earlier | 12 | 5 units |
| 16 September, one year earlier | 11 | not altered |
